question_fr: Films tournés en Islande mais dont l'intrigue se déroule ailleurs

assertion_refresh_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE FROM T_WC_T2S_MOVIE JOIN T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION filming_link ON filming_link.ID_MOVIE = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE JOIN T_WC_T2S_LOCATION_ANCESTOR filming_ancestor ON filming_ancestor.ID_LOCATION = filming_link.ID_LOCATION JOIN T_WC_T2S_LOCATION iceland ON iceland.ID_LOCATION = filming_ancestor.ID_ANCESTOR WHERE iceland.ID_WIKIDATA = 'Q189' AND iceland.DELETED = 0 AND filming_link.LOCATION_ROLE = 'filming' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION narrative_link WHERE narrative_link.ID_MOVIE = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE AND narrative_link.LOCATION_ROLE = 'narrative') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION narrative_here JOIN T_WC_T2S_LOCATION_ANCESTOR narrative_ancestor ON narrative_ancestor.ID_LOCATION = narrative_here.ID_LOCATION WHERE narrative_here.ID_MOVIE = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE AND narrative_here.LOCATION_ROLE = 'narrative' AND narrative_ancestor.ID_ANCESTOR = iceland.ID_LOCATION) ORDER BY T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.IMDB_RATING_WEIGHTED DESC LIMIT 15
